topPRs.title: feat: Arena-Z Sepolia fee vault recipient update task (sep/072)
topPRs.author: donoso-eth
topPRs.body:
Add task 072 to update fee vault recipient for Arena-Z testnet via L1→L2 deposit transactions. Includes UpdateFeeVaultRecipient template and integration test that replays deposits on L2 fork.

## Summary

Updates the fee vault recipient address on Arena-Z Sepolia (chain 9899) from 0x9648CF2B93DdBbe120812a567294B2954bCc8568 to 0xE75f598754A552841E65f43197C85028874A96a4

Deploys new fee vault implementations via L1→L2 deposit transactions through OptimismPortal, then upgrades all 3 fee vault proxies (SequencerFeeVault, BaseFeeVault, L1FeeVault)

Fee vaults have immutable recipients baked into constructor bytecode, so changing the recipient requires new impl deployments + proxy upgrades

## For Task PRs

**Task path**: `src/tasks/sep/072-arena-z-fee-vault-update`
**Tenderly simulation link**: 
Foundation: https://dashboard.tenderly.co/shared/simulation/9b83f4e6-75e2-42f1-93f5-3b791dee57ae
Council: https://dashboard.tenderly.co/shared/simulation/5ffefd51-5360-4194-9dbb-37651a7cb35f/state-diff

### Simulation Checklist

> These boxes must be checked before your PR can be merged.

- [x] I have run a Tenderly simulation for this task
- [x] I have reviewed and understand all state changes in the simulation
- [x] I have verified that every state change reflects the **exact expected value** (e.g., if setting an `absolutePrestate`, confirm the precise `bytes32` hash matches expectations)
- [x] All state changes match the expected behavior documented in `VALIDATION.md`
- [x] I can explain every state diff to reviewers and signers

### Task Checklist

- [x] `README.md` is complete with accurate task description
- [x] `VALIDATION.md` documents expected state changes with correct domain/message hashes
- [x] Task status is set appropriately
- [x] All TODOs in generated files have been addressed


## Additional context

Creation codes compiled from lib/optimism/packages/contracts-bedrock at submodule commit a10fd5259a (v1.5.0-beta.5)

BaseFeeVault version will change from 1.5.0-beta.6 to 1.5.0-beta.5 (cosmetic only, functionally identical — single byte difference in version string)

Includes reusable template (src/template/UpdateFeeVaultRecipient.sol) and integration test (test/integration/UpdateFeeVaultRecipientIntegration.t.sol)

topPRs.title: Arena-Z proposer rotation tasks for sepolia and mainnet
topPRs.author: Wazabie
topPRs.body:
Add proposer rotation tasks for Arena-Z (sep/072, eth/048) using SetDisputeGameImpl template. Updates pdgGameArgs with new AltLayer proposer addresses while keeping the same PDG implementation.

Fix SetDisputeGameImpl template to skip gameArgs format validation when fdgGameArgs or pdgGameArgs are empty, supporting permissioned-only chains like Arena-Z that have no FDG.
